preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of nodes n in the tree must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of nodes in both subtrees must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n for x_i in x) and all(1 <= y_i <= n for y_i in y)
preconditions.description: All node labels in both subtrees must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.
The lengths of the lists of nodes in both subtrees must match their respective counts.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'C s' and s in x and s in y
postconditions.description: If a common vertex exists, the output must be 'C s' where s is a valid label from both subtrees.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'C -1' and not any(s in x for s in y)
postconditions.description: If no common vertex exists, the output must be 'C -1'.
